Row '233 - פומלית- פריים 3 ש'': period '3 שנים', rate type 'משתנה', linkage 'אין', break 'לא ניתן לשבור', automatic renewal 'לא מתחדש', number of renewals 'לא מתחדש', exit points 'אין' 'אין', anchor 'P=4.75%', deposit options 'כיצד להפקיד'. Amount tiers merged into this record (each as printed): '100000' / 'P-3.29%' / '1.46%' / common '' / effective '1.46%'; '250000' / 'P-3.29%' / '1.46%' / common '' / effective '1.46%'; '1000000' / 'P-3.29%' / '1.46%' / common '' / effective '1.46%'; '1000000<' / 'P-3.29%' / '1.46%' / common '' / effective '1.46%'. Read 2026-11-09 from the table the page loads (https://www.mizrahi-tefahot.co.il/umbraco/surface/NabatDeposits/GetNabatDeposits?depositType=fixed&pageIndex=1&itemsPerPage=500&currencyCode=), 'כל המידע המוצג נכון לתאריך ושעה' 09/11/2026 08:31:13; amount tiers are printed as upper bounds under 'טווח סכום להפקדה (לא כולל)'.

tax_bucket.notes: Unlinked shekel deposit: interest taxed at 15% of the nominal interest (TXI-03); 'linked' means CPI or exchange rate, so an unlinked or prime-linked shekel deposit is in this bucket (TXI-04); the bank withholds 15% (TXI-08). Copied from the rule base (TXI-03's source, read 2026-10-25), not re-read today.
